results.snippet:
By Greg Miller

British police said Tuesday they had arrested a U.S. Army officer suspected of attempting to steal secret information from a NATO installation on British soil, to deliver that material to Russia.

The suspect, a 41-year-old U.S. Army officer, was arrested on suspicion of espionage as part of an operation involving Britain’s MI5 domestic security service in coordination with the FBI

results.title: U.S. Army Member Arrested in U.K. Over Allegations of Spying for Russia - WSJ
results.snippet:
LONDON—British counterterrorism police, working closely with the U.S. military and FBI, have arrested a member of the U.S. Army on allegations of spying for Russia.

The 41-year-old man was arrested near Gloucester on Tuesday. The area is home to Britain’s GCHQ, the country’s intelligence and cybersecurity agency, and the NATO Allied Rapid Reaction Corps.
